title: {{subscribe_tool}} — output
description: Output schema for the SOX subscribe operation. Returns the list of channels that currently exist in the backing store and match the registered pattern. An empty array is valid — it means the subscription was registered successfully but no matching channels exist yet. Future messages on matching channels will still be delivered to the subscribing agent. Normative reference: CONTRACTS.md §5.3.

subscribed.description: List of channel names that currently exist in the backing store and match the registered pattern. This is a snapshot at subscription time; the list may grow as new channels matching the pattern receive messages.
